scenario: two independent counters: offline sales and collections, reload, staggered reconnect, repeated sync and contested collection

checks.name: independent registered devices in the same synthetic shop
both counters start from stock 20 and udhar 1000
both counters have blocked network requests
counter A sale and payment survive offline reload
counter B sale and payment survive offline reload
counter B syncs while A retains its independent pending work
both counters converge to stock 18 and udhar 800
repeated sync preserves exactly two sales and two payments
reconciled values survive a second outage and document reload on both counters
competing offline collections cannot over-credit customer; rejected payment persists for owner review

limitations: Two disposable Chrome profiles on one computer, not physical till hardware.
Database engine is that of the configured QA API; this does not replace PostgreSQL concurrent-transaction certification.
Provider and hardware integrations are outside this test.
